args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 unhealthy — rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. Identified v2.3.0 as the most recent healthy production release. Rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0 in all production regions. Note: the initial rollback partially failed (only us-east completed due to an orchestrator error); a retry completed the rollout to us-west and eu-west. Post-rollback verification shows all regions healthy on v2.3.0 with error rate back to 0.2%. Follow-up: investigate the root cause of v2.3.1's failure before redeploying.

trace.final:
All done. Summary of what happened:

1. **Diagnosis:** checkout-api v2.3.1 (the latest deploy) was failing health checks in all three production regions with an 18% error rate. The most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rollback:** Rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). The first rollback attempt partially failed (only us-east completed due to an orchestrator error), so I retried and the rollout completed.
3. **Verification:** Post-rollback, all regions are healthy on v2.3.0 with the error rate back down to 0.2%.
4. **Incident:** Opened SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api v2.3.1 unhealthy — rolled back to v2.3.0") describing the failure, the rollback (including the partial-failure retry), the verified recovery, and a follow-up to investigate v2.3.1's root cause before redeploying. The on-call engineer has been paged.

No approval was needed for the rollback since v2.3.0 was previously healthy in production.
